title: Knoll of Gnolls
hardCanon: A secret cave hidden among rolling knolls contains more than forty keyed locations.
Claims that the gnolls are vicious and mutated are rumours until source details verify them.
Secret magics and ancient creatures are present in the source.
Permanent dungeon topology must come from the source maps.

rumours.claim: The gnolls are vicious and mutated.
rumours.aiRule: May be stated as rumour only until source evidence is discovered.

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Free-text plans may solve encounters creatively, but cannot rewrite the keyed map, source creature identity, secret locations or truth-state of rumours.
